details: The US economy added a stronger-than-expected 162,000 jobs in August, significantly exceeding Wall Street forecasts. This robust employment data has dampened expectations for near-term Federal Reserve interest rate cuts and provides the central bank more flexibility to maintain tight monetary policy, leading to a dip in Bitcoin and other risk assets.
title: Strong US Jobs Report Damps Fed Rate Cut Hopes, Pressuring Bitcoin

details: A Bitwise report indicates that Bitcoin's correlation with gold has reached a six-year high, while its correlation with traditional stock markets has fallen to a one-year low. This shift is attributed to significant US government intervention, including increased debt buybacks, which has weakened the dollar and encouraged investors to seek hedges against currency debasement in both gold and Bitcoin.
title: Bitcoin-Gold Correlation Hits Six-Year High Amid Dollar Weakness

details: US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) experienced a substantial $731 million in inflows on September 3rd, marking their strongest single-day performance since January. This significant capital influx suggests sustained institutional interest and demand for Bitcoin as an investment asset.
title: US Bitcoin ETFs Record Largest Inflow Day Since January

details: Solana validators have voted to pass a "double disinflation" plan aimed at significantly reducing the network's annual inflation rate to 1.5% within 2.8 years, accelerating the previous schedule. This initiative is expected to reduce the supply of SOL tokens by 18.9 million over the next six years.
title: Solana Validators Approve Proposal to Reduce Network Inflation Rate
